$comment: EFB-87 fixture. An allowlist entry for a route that reads its body through parseRouteBody — the state a migration leaves behind when step 4 (remove the route from the allowlist) is skipped. The checker must FAIL and name this entry. Sunset is in the past-proof range only because the test pins BOUNDARY_TODAY; a fixture whose outcome depends on the real date is a test that turns red on a calendar boundary rather than on a regression.
